briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ -0.2%, S&P 500 -0.2%), so we held existing positions rather than forcing trades. We added a single medium-conviction position in VALE, which showed strong, fully-confirmed bullish signals and adds sector diversification away from our tech-heavy holdings.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Diversification means spreading investments across different sectors so that a downturn in one area doesn't sink your whole portfolio. Today's portfolio was heavily weighted toward tech (QQQ, OLED, INOD, MU), so adding a materials-sector stock like VALE helps reduce that concentration risk.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 分散投資是指將資金分佈於不同行業，避免單一板塊下跌時拖累整個投資組合。現時組合偏重科技股（QQQ、OLED、INOD、MU），因此加入原材料板塊的VALE有助降低過度集中的風險。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices were essentially flat today, with the NASDAQ and S&P 500 both down about 0.2%, reflecting a lack of strong directional catalysts. Without a clear risk-on or risk-off trigger, broad market movement stayed muted while pockets of individual-stock strength persisted. This kind of quiet, range-bound session is common between major economic data releases or earnings catalysts.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市表現大致持平，納斯達克指數及標普500指數均微跌約0.2%，反映市場缺乏明顯的方向性催化劑。在沒有明確的風險偏好或避險訊號帶動下，大市整體波動有限，但個別股份仍錄得亮眼升勢。這種橫行整固的走勢，在重要經濟數據或業績公佈之間頗為常見。

trades.reasoning: Full multi-signal confirmation (RSI 55.9 bullish zone, MACD bullish crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge) with the least overbought RSI among the top-scoring candidates, and it diversifies the tech-heavy portfolio (QQQ, OLED, INOD, MU) into materials.
